_note: Strict, recipe-owned spec read by c-eval-runner. Targets the default 9:16 format — if format=16:9 is used the dims check will catch it. A brand may layer brand-overrides/<slug>/acceptance.json to TIGHTEN thresholds (same id wins; new ids appended). See c-eval-runner/SKILL.md for the spec format.

checks.desc: Mechanical gate (loudness ≈ -14 LUFS, frame-0 brightness, resolution 1080×1920, fps, audio present) delegated to c-shorts-qa-gate.
Snap bg-swap reel: 30–60s nominal; 27–63s allows ±3s for snap-boundary trim and encode rounding.
Exact 9:16 portrait canvas (default format=9:16). A landscape output fails here — check that format param was not overridden.
Center zone must have YAVG ≥ 16 at every sample — ensures each background segment has visible content and no composite segment came out as a black rectangle.

(a) Each background change fires exactly at the detected snap timestamp — the cut lands on the audible snap, not noticeably before or after it. Verify that snap-points.json timestamps align with visible cut frames.

(b) Chroma-key is clean on every segment — no green fringe or halo around the avatar; the two-pass colorkey (0.25:0.05 + 0.40:0.01) has fully removed green-screen residue across all background composites.
(c) Avatar is clearly composited over each background at the PIP position — well-framed, not floating off-center, not clipped, not smaller than the source PIP circle detected in Step 3.

(d) Each background segment has a visually distinct color palette or scene from the adjacent segments — the swap is immediately noticeable, matching the 'each bg: different color palette / scene / mood' requirement from Step 2.
(e) Frame 0 (cover) shows the avatar clearly composited over the first background — not black, not mid-transition, not the raw green-screen source.
Assembled snap concat must be full portrait canvas before final delivery processing.
Snap audio from the source greenscreen avatar must be present in the concat — snap sounds are needed for the sync effect; silent output means audio was dropped during colorkey composite.
